p: Commercial Road is Portsmouth's main pedestrianised shopping street, running past Cascades towards the Guildhall, so this Game Nation is right in the busiest part of the city centre. Portsmouth & Southsea station is a few minutes' walk south, near Guildhall Square.

There's a nice literary surprise just up the road too: Charles Dickens was born in Portsmouth, and his birthplace on Old Commercial Road is now a small museum. For the waterfront attractions, it's a short bus or train hop down to Portsmouth Harbour for the Historic Dockyard and Gunwharf Quays.
Game Nation is open to over-18s only, so carry ID if you look young.
